attractions.name: Torna Fort Trekking*
attractions.description: Embark on a thrilling trek to Torna Fort (Prachandagad), known for its historic significance and panoramic viewpoints. Experience heritage trails, fresh mountain air, and breathtaking Sahyadri scenery.

attractions.name: Madhe Ghat Waterfall (spot near Velhe)
attractions.description: Enjoy a monsoon escape to Madhe Ghat Waterfall—famous for cascading falls, misty trails, and lush greenery around Velhe. Perfect for nature lovers and photography during rains.

attractions.name: Rajgad Fort (Velhe belt)
attractions.description: Explore Rajgad Fort, one of Maharashtra’s most grand forts, set along scenic trekking routes. Discover Maratha heritage with rewarding views and rewarding outdoor walks.

attractions.name: Panshet Dam / lake views & leisure
attractions.description: Spend a relaxing day at Panshet Dam with calm lake views, leisure time, and outdoor photo moments. A peaceful destination for unwinding in nature.

attractions.name: Star Gazing: in Pabe Ghat, Kadve ghat
attractions.description: Witness clear night skies with a serene star-gazing experience at Pabe Ghat and Kadve Ghat. Enjoy a quiet evening away from city lights with unforgettable celestial views.

attractions.name: Waterfall Rapelling
attractions.description: Get an adrenaline boost with waterfall rapelling—an exciting adventure experience for thrill seekers. Enjoy guided safety and unforgettable moments by the falls.

attractions.name: Fishing  : In Gunjavni Dam or Panshet Backwaters
attractions.description: Try a relaxing fishing experience at Gunjavni Dam—calm waters, peaceful surroundings, and a great local activity for nature lovers.

attractions.name: Bullock Cart Ride: Resort to Bhatti Village
attractions.description: Experience a traditional bullock cart ride from the resort to Bhatti village—slow travel, countryside sights, and a memorable cultural ride.
